setting: a small kitchen with a formica table and a birthday cake with one lit candle

RAMIRO.corto: the short stocky butcher with a gray mustache in the white apron

LETICIA.corto: the very tall thin woman with a severe black bob and sunglasses on her head

momentos: {KLETI} picking up a knife and cutting a birthday cake with a cold face while {XRAMIRO} watches the candle
{XRAMIRO} looking up at his daughter with a hurt hopeful face, a lit candle in front of him
{KLETI} slamming her cup down on the table and standing up with a stern face
{XRAMIRO} sitting small and alone in front of the uneaten cake as {KLETI} leaves
camara: starting on the first gesture, circling the two and pushing in on their faces
ambiente: a cup slamming on a table, a chair scraping, a candle flame flickering

dialogos.texto: ¡Apá, esa señora no es de la familia!
¡Hija, es solo mi cumpleaños, por favor!
¡Está bien, hija, vete, ya me voy a soplar solo!
